reason: A race's own components carry nothing a label reads: its ability scores come from SelectableRaceStat or its heritage selection, and its traits are features it grants, each summarized apart.
text: +2 to one ability score of your choice. Orc ferocity keeps it on its feet, staggered, for a round after it would fall unconscious; +2 on Intimidate and Perception, proficient with greataxes and falchions, and a racial heritage can trade some of these traits for others.
